content:
Dear all,
together with @Laura Capuano, @Fabrizio Barroero, @Riccardo Brasca , @Kevin Buzzard, @Alessandro Iraci , @Marco Lenci , @Giovanni Paolini, @Amos Turchet and @Francesco Veneziano , we are organizing LFTCM 2026 at Scuola Normale Superiore in Cortona, Italy. The event will take place 7th-11th September, 2026: save the date!

It will be similar to LFTCM 2024, this time in Cortona, which is a beautiful medieval town located in Tuscany.

More details about inscriptions and fundings will come soon!
